title: Dropper for a constant-current load
description: A 15V supply must power a load that draws a constant 40mA, modeled as a current source that must appear exactly as 'Iload vout 0 DC 40m'. The netlist must also contain exactly 'V1 vin 0 DC 15' and a 1 ohm sense resistor 'Rsense vin top 1'. Design the network from 'top' to 'vout' so that 'vout' is 9.0V +/-5% and the total supply current (drop across Rsense) does not exceed 0.060V. Return a valid SPICE netlist.
